listings.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions.

listings.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. listings.title: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
listings.description: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d) Du kennst den Unterschied zwischen einer geschalteten Anzeige und einer funktionierenden Recruiting-Strategie? Und du willst nicht nur eine Position im Haus besetzen, sondern die Personalgewinnung ganzer Unternehmen verantworten? Dann lies weiter. Im klassischen Inhouse-Recruiting arbeitest du an den Stellen, die dir zugewiesen werden, mit dem Budget, das jemand anderes verhandelt hat. Bei uns läuft es umgekehrt: Du entscheidest, welche Unternehmen du gewinnst, wie ihre Recruiting-Strategie aussieht und über welche Kanäle die Besetzung läuft. Beratung, Umsetzung und Ergebnis liegen in einer Hand – deiner. Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung im Zentrum von Bielefeld. Wir machen Arbeitgeber sichtbar und liefern ihnen planbar passende Bewerbungen – über datengetriebene Kampagnen statt Zufallstreffer. Fachkräftemangel und demografische Entwicklung lassen diesen Markt jedes Jahr weiter wachsen. Deine Verantwortung Strategie und Beratung Du analysierst, warum die Personalgewinnung eines Unternehmens nicht liefert – Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Kanäle, Prozessgeschwindigkeit. Daraus entwickelst du eine belastbare Recruiting-Strategie und stellst sie den Entscheidern vor. Du gewinnst neue Kunden aktiv: über Telefon, Direktansprache und Empfehlungen. Kampagnen und Besetzung Du planst Recruiting-Kampagnen, steuerst sie über die Laufzeit und justierst anhand der Zahlen nach. Du prüfst eingehende Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche zur Vorauswahl und gestaltest eine Candidate Experience, die im Gedächtnis bleibt. Bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung bleibt das Projekt in deiner Hand. Daten und Weiterentwicklung Du arbeitest sauber im CRM, kennst deine Kennzahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung schärfst du unsere Methodik weiter. Dein Profil Recruiting-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Zielgruppenansprache, Kanalauswahl und Prozessgestaltung zusammenwirken – ob aus Agentur, Personaldiens

listings.title: Senior Director, Clinical Research - Neurodegeneration
listings.description:
Overview

Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking an imaginative physician drug developer. This is an opportunity to provide clinical leadership in developing RNAi therapeutics in Alnylam’s rapidly expanding portfolio, which spans the areas of rare genetic diseases, cardio-metabolic diseases, neuroscience, hematology and hepatology.

The successful candidate’s primary role will be to drive the pipeline forward through leadership of clinical development programs.  While the primary focus responsibility will be as clinical lead physician on Alnylam’s Huntington’s program, the role may support across a range of therapeutic areas and all stages of development may be required as pipeline assets evolve. The Sr. Director is expected to play a leading and influencing role in the overall clinical development strategies and drive progress and operational excellence for associated clinical trials. In addition, this role will include interaction with Alnylam’s research group, helping to advise the team on the clinical development feasibility of novel targets and the design of proof-of-concept studies. This work will also involve extensive consultation and collaboration with external experts. It is expected that additional opportunities will arise to lead bench-to-bedside early phase clinical development programs.

The Senior Director, Clinical Research, will work in a matrix organization across Regulatory, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Preclinical, Commercial & QA teams to ensure fully harmonized and integrated development strategies. They will be a key Alnylam Development spokesperson at external meetings, including regulatory interactions and scientific meetings.

This position is hybrid and will be primarily located at our Cambridge, MA headquarters or Maidenhead, UK location.

Key Responsibilities

  • Be the strategic leader providing a strong, clear voice for the clinical programs

listings.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Ads Bidding
listings.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Staff Machine Learning Engineer – Ads Bidding

The Team

The Ads ML team builds and maintains the machine learning models powering Deliveroo's advertising product — connecting consumers with relevant ads and helping merchants, grocers, and FMCG brands grow through the platform. The UK team is ~11 MLEs across ads and promotions, and collaborates closely with the US team (meetings capped at 4pm UK to protect reasonable hours).

The Problem

Deliveroo is migrating ads from cost-per-click (CPC) to cost-per-order (CPO) — merchants pay when an ad drives an order, not when it's clicked. This is a genuinely open, cutting-edge problem: very few companies have solved it, and there's no established playbook to follow. The exact approach is under active discussion and you'd be central to driving it.

You will:

  • Own the design and execution of the CPC-to-CPO migration, including the core open question of whether the system stays CPO-facing externally while optimising CPC behind the scenes, or some hybrid of the two

  • Build and improve the bidding surface: goal-based automated bidding, Target CPO, optimised CPC, and Target ROAS

  • Own yield management tied to ROS targeting

  • Partner daily with the DoorDash US team to align on approach across markets

  • Set technical direction for the domain

Requirements

  • Expertise in ad economics, marketplace bidding, or auction theory

Contribute to publications and collaborations with academic partners, including research ecosystem. Present your work internally and at scientific conferences and technical events. listings.title: Customer Success Manager
listings.description:
About RELEX

RELEX Solutions creates cutting-edge supply chain and retail planning software. Within our platforms, we have the power and potential to increase adaptability, efficiency and sustainability in the consumer 
goods and retail value chain. Our impact is tangible; from sustainability and eliminating waste to delighting customers and delivering great tailored tech solutions, we’re curious and passionate challenge-seekers creating the future of retail today. 

In times of rapidly changing, fragmented consumer demand, new sales and fulfillment channels, and supply chain disruption, RELEX’s AI-driven, cloud-based platform helps CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods) brands and retailers move fast and find new ways to meet consumer needs while improving operational efficiency and controlling costs. 

In response to our fast growth and market expansion, we are looking for an enthusiastic Customer Success Manager to join our RELEX team in France. 

The role: 

As a Customer Success Manager you will work with strategic development of our customers business processes. You will also be responsible for developing and maintaining executive/senior level customer relationships, contribute to revenue growth by generating and upsell/cross-sell cases within your existing customer base.
